title: Keep implementation agents from self-approving repository PRs
lane_outcome: Issue #2725 is satisfied in this repository without controlling AW consumers: implementation agents never approve their own PRs, and only the separately configured review automation owns authoritative markers.
purpose_for_parent: Restores the protected reviewer boundary required before later enforcement and delegation claims can be trusted.
technical_strategy: Keep the boundary in repo-owned maintainer guidance, marker intake, and the exact-head merge gate; remove portable AW review-procedure machinery.
technology_choices: Treat the separately configured ChatGPT review automation's REST performed_via_github_app metadata as this repo's dispatcher identity.
Keep implementation status marker-free and preserve the existing exact-head review policy without signatures or consumer-facing attestations.
